title: How a Paradise Became a Death Trap

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西，这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: On Monday, we heard the story of Wyola Church and what was lost in the wildfires on Maui.
sentences.zh: 周一，我们听到了怀奥拉教堂的故事，以及毛伊岛野火中失去的一切。

sentences.en: What we didn't know then was the sheer scale of the catastrophe, what it felt like to experience it, and how it could be that so many people died.
sentences.zh: 当时我们不知道的是，这场灾难的规模竟如此之大，亲历其中的感受如何，以及为何会有这么多人丧生。

sentences.en: One hundred and eleven in the latest count.
sentences.zh: 最新统计显示，死亡人数已达一百一十一人。

sentences.en: Today, the miraculous story of one man who survived, and my colleague in Hawaii, Mike Baker,
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将讲述一位幸存者的奇迹故事，以及我在夏威夷的同事迈克·贝克带来的报道，

sentences.en: on how an extraordinary set of circumstances came together to turn Lahaina into a death trap.
sentences.zh: 讲述一系列非同寻常的情况是如何交织在一起，将拉海纳变成了一座死亡陷阱。

sentences.en: It's Friday, August 18th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月18日，星期五。

sentences.en: Hi, is this Idris?
sentences.zh: 你好，是伊德里斯吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it is.
sentences.zh: 是的，我是。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Idris, thank you for taking the time to talk to us, and I wonder, Idris, if you could introduce yourself for me.
sentences.zh: 伊德里斯，感谢你抽出时间接受我们的采访。我想请你先做个自我介绍。

sentences.en: Tell me your name, your age, where you live, and what your profession is.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你的名字、年龄、住处以及你的职业。

sentences.en: My name is Idris Noira.
sentences.zh: 我叫伊德里斯·诺伊拉。

sentences.en: I'm 32 years old.
sentences.zh: 我今年32岁。

sentences.en: I lived on Prison Street in Maui, Lahaina,
sentences.zh: 我住在毛伊岛拉海纳的监狱街，

sentences.en: and I was the manager of a Hilton property of the Beach and Pool.
sentences.zh: 我曾是希尔顿酒店海滩和泳池区域的经理。

sentences.en: I work in sales.
sentences.zh: 我现在从事销售工作。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And I wonder if you could start by telling us just kind of from the beginning how your day started.
sentences.zh: 我想请你从头开始讲起，你那天是怎么开始的？

sentences.en: So, actually, it was my first true day off in a long time.
sentences.zh: 其实，那是我很久以来第一个真正的休息日。

sentences.en: And I woke up in the middle of the night, which was Monday night, Tuesday morning, around 3 or 4 a.m.
sentences.zh: 我在半夜醒来，那是周一晚上到周二凌晨，大约三四点钟，

sentences.en: when we lost power.
sentences.zh: 当时我们停电了。

sentences.en: So, it got pretty hot.
sentences.zh: 屋里变得很热。

sentences.en: So, I opened up the windows, and by the time I woke up around 6, 7 a.m., I noticed we didn't have service neither.
sentences.zh: 于是我打开了窗户，等到六七点钟醒来时，我发现手机也没信号了。

sentences.en: Cell service.
sentences.zh: 手机信号。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: No more front service, no power.
sentences.zh: 没有服务，也没有电。

sentences.en: It was very windy.
sentences.zh: 风很大。

sentences.en: So, I texted the front desk manager to ask them about my staff.
sentences.zh: 我给前台经理发了短信，询问我的员工情况。

sentences.en: I wanted to make sure they were safe.
sentences.zh: 我想确保他们是安全的。

sentences.en: And they told me that they were keeping the pool open.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我，泳池还在正常开放。

sentences.en: And, honestly, I was just annoyed.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我当时挺烦的。

sentences.en: I was like, I've been waiting for this day off forever, and no power, it's windy.
sentences.zh: 我就想，我盼了这么久的休息日，结果没电，风又大。

sentences.en: And I was, like, kind of complaining.
sentences.zh: 我当时就在那儿抱怨。

sentences.en: You know, no one knew, you know, that it was going to get to that point.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当时没人知道情况会演变成那样。

sentences.en: You know, we didn't even know it was a hurricane.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至不知道那是飓风。

sentences.en: We just thought it was windy.
sentences.zh: 我们只以为风大而已。

sentences.en: So, I went on my day and put up the cabinets in my bathroom.
sentences.zh: 于是我继续过我的日子，开始安装浴室的柜子。

sentences.en: And then I, you know, started reading my Kindle.
sentences.zh: 然后我就开始读我的Kindle。

sentences.en: And that was pretty much just one of those days.
sentences.zh: 那差不多就是那样的一天。

sentences.en: And were you aware of the fire at that point?
sentences.zh: 那时你意识到有火灾了吗？

sentences.en: Oh, absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 哦，绝对没有。

sentences.en: There was no fire in the morning that I was aware of.
sentences.zh: 我早上完全不知道有火灾。

sentences.en: We had no warnings at all.
sentences.zh: 我们根本没有任何预警。

sentences.en: And so, I think it was around noon or one, one of my neighbors came and knocked on my door.
sentences.zh: 我想大概是中午或一点左右，我的一位邻居来敲我的门。

sentences.en: And he said, hey, you need to come out and see this.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，你得出来看看这个。

sentences.en: So, I came out.
sentences.zh: 于是我出来了。

sentences.en: And in front of my house, you know, I have a little cottage.
sentences.zh: 在我房子前面，你知道，我住的是个小屋。

sentences.en: Behind my house, I could see a lot of smoke.
sentences.zh: 在我房子后面，我能看到很多烟。

sentences.en: And it was kind of far, maybe like a mile, maybe a little less than a mile away.
sentences.zh: 离得有点远，可能有一英里，或者不到一英里。

sentences.en: And it was a lot of smoke.
sentences.zh: 烟非常多。

sentences.en: There were black smokers.
sentences.zh: 那是黑烟。

sentences.en: I go, something's burning.
sentences.zh: 我说，有什么东西着火了。

sentences.en: And all our neighbors were meeting.
sentences.zh: 所有的邻居都聚在一起。

sentences.en: They were talking about an escape plan.
sentences.zh: 他们在讨论逃生计划。

sentences.en: And I said, you know, it's kind of far away.
sentences.zh: 我说，离得还挺远的。

sentences.en: We have scooters and bikes.
sentences.zh: 我们有滑板车和自行车。

sentences.en: And I don't think it's safe to be on the road anyways.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得现在上路也不安全。

sentences.en: You know, we'll be safer in our homes.
sentences.zh: 待在家里会更安全。

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的。

sentences.en: So, I called my cat.
sentences.zh: 于是我呼唤我的猫。

sentences.en: It's an outdoor cat.
sentences.zh: 它是只散养猫。

sentences.en: And I called her.
sentences.zh: 我叫了它。

sentences.en: And I couldn't find her all day.
sentences.zh: 但我一整天都没找到它。

sentences.en: And then I just gave up.
sentences.zh: 后来我就放弃了。

sentences.en: And I went home.
sentences.zh: 我回了家。

sentences.en: And I closed my door.
sentences.zh: 关上了门。

sentences.en: And then my neighbor came back, maybe an hour later.
sentences.zh: 大约一小时后，邻居又回来了。

sentences.en: And he said, there's another fire.
sentences.zh: 他说，又起火了。

sentences.en: And it was closer.
sentences.zh: 这次更近了。

sentences.en: It was actually the street behind us.
sentences.zh: 其实就在我们后面的那条街。

sentences.en: And I have a scooter.
sentences.zh: 我有一辆滑板车。

sentences.en: So, I actually went to go check out how close the fire was.
sentences.zh: 于是我骑车去看了看火势有多近。

sentences.en: It was pretty close, but still kind of far away.
sentences.zh: 离得挺近，但还是有点距离。

sentences.en: It was in front of an apartment complex.
sentences.zh: 火就在一个公寓大楼前面。

sentences.en: And right across from that, there was another house.
sentences.zh: 对面还有一栋房子。

sentences.en: And there were bushes that were starting to catch on fire.
sentences.zh: 那里的灌木丛开始着火了。

sentences.en: So, I parked my scooter.
sentences.zh: 我停好滑板车。

sentences.en: And I ran into the yard.
sentences.zh: 跑进院子里。

sentences.en: And I was looking, you know, for the neighbors to ask them for their hose.
sentences.zh: 我四处寻找邻居，想管他们借水管。

sentences.en: Because I wanted to, like, it was small enough to, like, put down.
sentences.zh: 因为我想，火势还小，应该能扑灭。

sentences.en: And so, I saw the neighbors.
sentences.zh: 我看到了邻居。

sentences.en: They were already in their car in the driveway.
sentences.zh: 他们已经坐在车道上的车里了。

sentences.en: So, I knocked on the window.
sentences.zh: 我敲了敲车窗。

sentences.en: And the guy didn't even say.
sentences.zh: 那个人甚至没说话。

sentences.en: He didn't even respond.
sentences.zh: 他甚至没有回应。

sentences.en: I don't remember him responding.
sentences.zh: 我不记得他有回应。

sentences.en: And by the time I went back in the garden to find the hose, another guy saw it and grabbed it.
sentences.zh: 当我回到花园找水管时，另一个人看到了，就抓起水管。

sentences.en: And we were, like, pulling down the fire in his bushes.
sentences.zh: 我们一起扑灭了灌木丛里的火。

sentences.en: And after that, I got on Front Street, which is a street that goes along, you know, the ocean.
sentences.zh: 之后，我到了前街，那是沿着海边的一条路。

sentences.en: And I see there's this restaurant up in flame.
sentences.zh: 我看到一家餐馆燃起了大火。

sentences.en: And I'm like, okay, what's going on?
sentences.zh: 我心想，好吧，这是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Like, how is this this big?
sentences.zh: 怎么会火势这么大？

sentences.en: It just didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: It didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 完全没道理。

sentences.en: So, I couldn't go through.
sentences.zh: 我没法通过了。

sentences.en: There was so much smoke and fire.
sentences.zh: 到处都是浓烟和火焰。

sentences.en: What time is it at that point, Idris?
sentences.zh: 伊德里斯，当时是几点？

sentences.en: What time is it?
sentences.zh: 几点了？

sentences.en: I think like 2.30.
sentences.zh: 我想大概两点半吧。

sentences.en: You know, it had to be 2 or 2.30.
sentences.zh: 肯定是在两点或两点半左右。

sentences.en: Something like that.
sentences.zh: 差不多那样。

sentences.en: And I remember seeing, like, a white SUV.
sentences.zh: 我记得看到一辆白色SUV。

sentences.en: And this Asian woman was trying to cut in line.
sentences.zh: 有个亚裔女性试图插队。

sentences.en: She couldn't even cut in line.
sentences.zh: 她甚至插不进去。

sentences.en: Clearly, she was panicking.
sentences.zh: 显然，她当时很恐慌。

sentences.en: And I saw people running.
sentences.zh: 我看到人们在奔跑。

sentences.en: And straight in front of me, there's a medical center.
sentences.zh: 就在我正前方，有一个医疗中心。

sentences.en: And I remember, actually, seeing a line of people trying to get in the medical center.
sentences.zh: 我记得当时看到一排人试图进入医疗中心。

sentences.en: They were all staying in front of me.
sentences.zh: 他们都站在我前面。

sentences.en: And there's a big parking lot.
sentences.zh: 那里有个大停车场。

sentences.en: So, they were taking shelter in it.
sentences.zh: 所以他们都在那里避难。

sentences.en: It was pretty bad.
sentences.zh: 情况相当糟糕。

sentences.en: It was pretty bad.
sentences.zh: 真的非常糟糕。

sentences.en: I was on Front Street.
sentences.zh: 我当时在前街。

sentences.en: And so, I made a right.
sentences.zh: 于是我向右转。

sentences.en: I turned my head.
sentences.zh: 我转过头。

sentences.en: And behind me, there's a whole business on fire.
sentences.zh: 在我身后，整栋商业建筑都在燃烧。

sentences.en: I was like, holy.
sentences.zh: 我当时惊呆了。

sentences.en: Like, everything was on fire.
sentences.zh: 一切都在燃烧。

sentences.en: Like, I didn't understand how things started to catch on fire.
sentences.zh: 我不明白东西是怎么开始着火的。

sentences.en: It didn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 这根本说不通。

sentences.en: And now, I started to panic.
sentences.zh: 现在，我开始恐慌了。

sentences.en: Idris, what did you think at that moment when you came back to your house and the neighbors were all gone?
sentences.zh: 伊德里斯，当你回到家发现邻居们都不见了，你当时在想什么？

sentences.en: I felt kind of loSt.
sentences.zh: 我感到有些迷茫。

sentences.en: And the wind, you know, there was wind.
sentences.zh: 风很大，你知道，到处都是风。

sentences.en: And there was trees falling down.
sentences.zh: 树木不断倒下。

sentences.en: And I screamed for my cat.
sentences.zh: 我大声呼唤我的猫。

sentences.en: And I saw her run under the house.
sentences.zh: 我看到它跑到了房子下面。

sentences.en: And she didn't want to come out.
sentences.zh: 它不肯出来。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: So, I was panicking.
sentences.zh: 我当时很恐慌。

sentences.en: You know, reality started to set in.
sentences.zh: 现实开始显现了。

sentences.en: And so, I said, okay.
sentences.zh: 于是我说，好吧。

sentences.en: Maybe, you know, the safest place to be right now is here.
sentences.zh: 也许现在最安全的地方就是这里。

sentences.en: Because I wouldn't even know where to go.
sentences.zh: 因为我根本不知道该去哪儿。

sentences.en: And so, I'm closing the door.
sentences.zh: 于是我关上了门。

sentences.en: And about five minutes, everything turned black outside.
sentences.zh: 大约五分钟后，外面的一切都变黑了。

sentences.en: And so, I opened the curtain.
sentences.zh: 我拉开窗帘。

sentences.en: And I saw that medical center across the street was up in flame to the sky.
sentences.zh: 我看到街对面的医疗中心火光冲天。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And I couldn't understand.
sentences.zh: 我无法理解。

sentences.en: I said, how?
sentences.zh: 我说，怎么会？

sentences.en: Like, I just saw people.
sentences.zh: 我刚才还看到有人。

sentences.en: Like, there was nothing, like, five, ten minutes ago.
sentences.zh: 五到十分钟前，那里明明什么都没有。

sentences.en: And it really looked like someone put gasoline all over the building.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像有人在整栋建筑上泼了汽油一样。

sentences.en: And it just, like, took up in flame.
sentences.zh: 它瞬间就燃起了大火。

sentences.en: It didn't make sense how, like, a stone building could burn so faSt.
sentences.zh: 我不明白一栋石砌建筑怎么能烧得这么快。

sentences.en: And so, I opened the door, still calling my cat.
sentences.zh: 于是我打开门，继续呼唤我的猫。

sentences.en: And I felt something burning on my shoulder.
sentences.zh: 我感觉到肩膀上有东西在灼烧。

sentences.en: And it was debris, like amber.
sentences.zh: 那是些碎片，看起来像琥珀一样。

sentences.en: And I look up in the sky, and there's literally fire coming down the sky.
sentences.zh: 我抬头看向天空，真的有火从天上掉下来。

sentences.en: Like, it was raining fire.
sentences.zh: 就像是在下火雨一样。

sentences.en: And now, I said, I have to get out of here.
sentences.zh: 当时我就说，我必须离开这里。

sentences.en: What time was that, Idris?
sentences.zh: 那是几点钟的事，Idris？

sentences.en: About three o'clock, I'd say.
sentences.zh: 我想大概是三点左右。

sentences.en: I noticed that the neighbors had turned all the hose and wet, got everything wet.
sentences.zh: 我注意到邻居们把所有的水管都打开了，把周围都弄湿了。

sentences.en: So, I took one of the hose and got my door wet and, you know, trying to, we still thought that we could prevent, you know, prevent anything from happening.
sentences.zh: 于是，我也拿了一根水管把我的门弄湿，你知道的，我们当时还觉得能阻止，能阻止事情发生。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And so, you know, I got everything I could, you know, all the necessities, clothes and wallet and, you know, pictures or whatever, and put everything in two big bags.
sentences.zh: 所以，我尽可能地收拾了所有东西，你知道的，所有的必需品、衣服、钱包，还有照片之类的，把一切都装进了两个大袋子里。

sentences.en: And I ran out of the house.
sentences.zh: 然后我跑出了房子。

sentences.en: And I saw one of my neighbors coughing.
sentences.zh: 我看到我的一个邻居在咳嗽。

sentences.en: He was right in front of the house, in front of the street.
sentences.zh: 他就站在房子前面，街道前面。

sentences.en: And he was just coughing.
sentences.zh: 他一直在咳嗽。

sentences.en: And I said, what are you doing here?
sentences.zh: 我说，你在这儿干什么？

sentences.en: He's like, oh, I went to the store.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，我刚去商店回来。

sentences.en: And I said, okay, let's get on my scooter.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，快上我的摩托车。

sentences.en: So, he came behind me on my scooter.
sentences.zh: 于是，他坐到我后面，上了我的摩托车。

sentences.en: Fire came from uphill.
sentences.zh: 火从山上烧过来了。

sentences.en: It was coming down.
sentences.zh: 它正在蔓延下来。

sentences.en: So, to me, the safest place of this fire is water.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这场火灾中最安全的地方就是水里。

sentences.en: And so, you know, in the panic, I was like, we have to go to the harbor.
sentences.zh: 在那种恐慌中，我当时想，我们必须去港口。

sentences.en: And then I couldn't even get on Prison Street because there was a power line that was down.
sentences.zh: 结果我连Prison街都进不去，因为有一根电线掉下来了。

sentences.en: It was moving so fast with the wind, and it was so much smoke.
sentences.zh: 火势借着风力蔓延得太快了，烟雾也非常浓。

sentences.en: So, I went in the parking lot across where the medical center was burning, and it was full of smoke.
sentences.zh: 所以我开进了医疗中心对面的停车场，那里正在燃烧，到处都是烟。

sentences.en: And I almost hit a car that was parked, but it was on.
sentences.zh: 我差点撞上一辆停着的车，但车是发动着的。

sentences.en: I saw it with the brake lights, and there was a door open.
sentences.zh: 我看到了刹车灯亮着，而且车门开着。

sentences.en: And this tall Hawaiian man came out, and he was just waving his arms, and he was screaming.
sentences.zh: 一个高大的夏威夷男人从车里出来，他挥舞着双臂，在大声尖叫。

sentences.en: I didn't know what he was saying.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他在说什么。

sentences.en: He was clearly speaking English, but he was just panicked.
sentences.zh: 他显然是在说英语，但他当时完全陷入了恐慌。

sentences.en: I don't remember.
sentences.zh: 我不记得了。

sentences.en: I just remember his face.
sentences.zh: 我只记得他的脸。

sentences.en: His eyes and his eyebrows were just raised up to the max.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛和眉毛都瞪到了极限。

sentences.en: And he's now, like I said, he was just speaking gibberish to me.
sentences.zh: 就像我说的，他当时对我语无伦次。

sentences.en: And there was so much noise outside, the wind and the explosions, and I didn't know what he was saying.
sentences.zh: 外面噪音太大了，风声和爆炸声，我根本听不清他在说什么。

sentences.en: And there was no way he could get on the scooter with us, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且他根本没法和我们一起坐摩托车，你知道的。

sentences.en: His eyes closed.
sentences.zh: 闭着眼睛。

sentences.en: And they're just screaming.
sentences.zh: 一直在叫。

sentences.en: There's no way I could carry him.
sentences.zh: 我根本没法抱着它。

sentences.en: It's a big pit bull.
sentences.zh: 那是一只大比特犬。

sentences.en: And I had one, you know, and my hand was fractured or broken.
sentences.zh: 而且我，你知道，我的手骨折了。

sentences.en: And so I thought, if I try to grab him in the water, he's already freaked out.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果我在水里试图抓住它，它已经吓坏了。

sentences.en: We're both going to drown.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都会淹死。

sentences.en: You know, he's going to die for sure.
sentences.zh: 你知道，它肯定会死。

sentences.en: And I'm probably not going to make it.
sentences.zh: 而我可能也活不下来。

sentences.en: So in one of my bags, I had a blanket, like, a small blanket, like, for my sofa.
sentences.zh: 所以，在我的一个包里，有一条毯子，那种小毯子，我沙发上用的那种。

sentences.en: And I dipped it in the ocean five or six times.
sentences.zh: 我把它在海里浸了五六次。

sentences.en: And I put it on top of the dog.
sentences.zh: 然后盖在狗身上。

sentences.en: That's all I could do.
sentences.zh: 我只能做到这些了。

sentences.en: And I took one of my bags, and I jumped back in the ocean.
sentences.zh: 我拿上我的一个包，跳回了海里。

sentences.en: And then I almost drowned.
sentences.zh: 然后我差点淹死。

sentences.en: I was just so exhausted, and I panicked halfway.
sentences.zh: 我太累了，游到一半时陷入了恐慌。

sentences.en: And I was praying to God, please help me.
sentences.zh: 我向上帝祈祷，请帮帮我。

sentences.en: And I thanked God I made it to the jetty, and I went back on the other side.
sentences.zh: 感谢上帝，我游回了防波堤，又回到了另一边。

sentences.en: I talked to Damon, and he was not answering.
sentences.zh: 我跟达蒙说话，他没回应。

sentences.en: And I grabbed his hand, and he just held my hand.
sentences.zh: 我抓住他的手，他紧紧握住我的手。

sentences.en: He was just in shock.
sentences.zh: 他当时处于休克状态。

sentences.en: He wasn't saying anything.
sentences.zh: 他什么也没说。

sentences.en: I was holding Damon's hand for about a couple hours, and it felt like the wind calmed down.
sentences.zh: 我握着达蒙的手大概有两个小时，感觉风平息了一些。

sentences.en: And I remember I was grabbing Damon's hand, and I said,
sentences.zh: 我记得我当时握着达蒙的手，我说，

sentences.en: Oh, the wind kind of calmed down.
sentences.zh: 哦，风好像停了。

sentences.en: And as soon as I said that, everything lit up.
sentences.zh: 我刚说完，周围一切都亮了起来。

sentences.en: And I turned around, and I saw a line of boats on fire coming towards us.
sentences.zh: 我转过身，看到一排着火的船正朝我们漂过来。

sentences.en: I remember saying to Damon, you've got to be kidding me.
sentences.zh: 我记得我对达蒙说，你在开玩笑吧。

sentences.en: All the boats that were tied to the harbor, all the ropes, you know, burned down.
sentences.zh: 所有系在港口的船，所有的缆绳，你知道，都烧断了。

sentences.en: And they were following the current back to sea.
sentences.zh: 它们顺着水流漂回海里。

sentences.en: And they were all following each other on a perfect line.
sentences.zh: 它们排成一条完美的直线，一艘接一艘。

sentences.en: You would think that someone was on the boat steering them.
sentences.zh: 你会以为船上有人在掌舵。

sentences.en: I had to tell Damon, you're seeing this, right?
sentences.zh: 我不得不告诉达蒙，你看到了吗？

sentences.en: And he's like, yeah.
sentences.zh: 他说，看到了。

sentences.en: And they were getting really close to us, almost circling us.
sentences.zh: 它们离我们越来越近，几乎要把我们包围了。

sentences.en: You feel the heat, and then, you know, they were exploding.
sentences.zh: 你能感觉到热浪，然后，你知道，它们爆炸了。

sentences.en: And thank God, they followed the current up to sea.
sentences.zh: 谢天谢地，它们顺着水流漂向了大海。

sentences.en: They went straight out instead of going all the way around.
sentences.zh: 它们直接漂了出去，而不是绕过来。

sentences.en: And then maybe an hour after that, I saw a light at, you know, far away.
sentences.zh: 大约一小时后，我看到远处有一道光。

sentences.en: And I told Damon, I said, Hey, I think there's a boat over there.
sentences.zh: 我告诉达蒙，我说，嘿，那边好像有艘船。

sentences.en: And we were, like, screaming.
sentences.zh: 我们当时，就在大喊。

sentences.en: I was screaming at the top of my lungs.
sentences.zh: 我用尽全身力气大喊。

sentences.en: And they were, like, coming towards us, like, thank God.
sentences.zh: 他们正朝我们过来，谢天谢地。

sentences.en: Oh, my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: They were screaming so hard.
sentences.zh: 他们喊得很大声。

sentences.en: And the surfer was screaming.
sentences.zh: 那个冲浪者也在喊。

sentences.en: And it was the Coast Guard.
sentences.zh: 是海岸警卫队。

sentences.en: And they were like, We can't get close.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们没法靠近。

sentences.en: You guys have to jump in the water.
sentences.zh: 你们得跳进水里。

sentences.en: You know, because it was so rough.
sentences.zh: 你知道，因为浪太大了。

sentences.en: They were crashing the rocks.
sentences.zh: 他们正撞向岩石。

sentences.en: And then, out of nowhere, there's a couple that were standing in front of the Harbor Masses hut.
sentences.zh: 然后，不知从哪儿冒出来一对夫妇，站在港口小屋前。

sentences.en: And they had no clothes.
sentences.zh: 他们没穿衣服。

sentences.en: They only had shorts or swimming suits.
sentences.zh: 只穿着短裤或泳装。

sentences.en: And that guy who had shorts, he was just red.
sentences.zh: 那个穿短裤的男人，全身通红。

sentences.en: Like, he was just burnt from the wind.
sentences.zh: 就像是被风灼伤了一样。

sentences.en: He was just, I could see even from there, you know, he was all red.
sentences.zh: 他就是，我甚至从那儿都能看出来，你知道，他全身都红了。

sentences.en: And I kept screaming, Jump in the water, jump in the water.
sentences.zh: 我一直大喊，跳进水里，跳进水里。

sentences.en: But, you know, I don't think he was just processing anything.
sentences.zh: 但，你知道，我觉得他当时什么都处理不了。

sentences.en: So, the Coast Guards came and got him.
sentences.zh: 所以，海岸警卫队过来接走了他。

sentences.en: And then, they came to us laSt.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们最后才来接我们。

sentences.en: And I jumped firSt.
sentences.zh: 我先跳了下去。

sentences.en: And they got me in.
sentences.zh: 他们把我拉了上去。

sentences.en: I just laid down on my back.
sentences.zh: 我只是躺在背上。

sentences.en: And I could just see amber just falling on us.
sentences.zh: 我能看到余烬不断落在我们身上。

sentences.en: Like, the sky had no stars.
sentences.zh: 就像天空没有星星一样。

sentences.en: The amber was the stars.
sentences.zh: 余烬就是星星。

sentences.en: Red stars in the sky.
sentences.zh: 天上的红星。

sentences.en: That's what it looked like.
sentences.zh: 看起来就是那样。

sentences.en: Just a black sky with red stars.
sentences.zh: 漆黑的天空点缀着红星。

sentences.en: Just falling down.
sentences.zh: 不断坠落。

sentences.en: And I was falling on the ocean.
sentences.zh: 我当时正坠入大海。

sentences.en: But I felt like I was falling in space.
sentences.zh: 但我感觉自己像是坠入了太空。

sentences.en: It's hard to describe because everything happened so faSt.
sentences.zh: 很难描述，因为一切发生得太快了。

sentences.en: But, I was thanking God.
sentences.zh: 但我一直在感谢上帝。

sentences.en: I was like, thank you, thank you, thank you.
sentences.zh: 我一直在说，谢谢，谢谢，谢谢。

sentences.en: I don't deserve this.
sentences.zh: 我不配得到这些。

sentences.en: I really just, it was just unbelievable that we made it.
sentences.zh: 我真的，我们能活下来简直不可思议。

sentences.en: Damon, man, he managed to make it.
sentences.zh: 达蒙，伙计，他居然活下来了。

sentences.en: He managed to get out, get in the water.
sentences.zh: 他设法逃了出来，跳进了水里。

sentences.en: I don't know how.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他是怎么做到的。

sentences.en: I don't even see him.
sentences.zh: 我甚至没看到他。

sentences.en: But I remember they pulled him in.
sentences.zh: 但我记得他们把他拉了上来。

sentences.en: I was like, thank God.
sentences.zh: 我当时想，谢天谢地。

sentences.en: We made it.
sentences.zh: 我们活下来了。

sentences.en: And I said, oh, how did you guys find us?
sentences.zh: 我说，哦，你们是怎么找到我们的？

sentences.en: And they said, we got a call that someone might be on the harbor.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们接到电话说有人可能在港口。

sentences.en: So, I think that lady, you know, she relayed the call and finally got to us.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想那位女士，你知道，她转达了求救电话，最终传到了我们这里。

sentences.en: And I said, thank God we made it.
sentences.zh: 我说，谢天谢地我们活下来了。

sentences.en: And he said, oh, no, not yet.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，不，还没结束。

sentences.en: We still have to go through the storm.
sentences.zh: 我们还得穿过那场风暴。

sentences.en: And I said, where are we going?
sentences.zh: 我问，我们要去哪儿？

sentences.en: And he said, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们也不知道。

sentences.en: Everything's on fire.
sentences.zh: 到处都在着火。

sentences.en: And I looked behind me and there was just, it was just, it looked like war.
sentences.zh: 我回头看了一眼，那景象，简直就像战争一样。

sentences.en: It was just flames up to the sky.
sentences.zh: 火焰直冲云霄。

sentences.en: The whole, I mean, the whole town.
sentences.zh: 整个，我是说，整个镇子。

sentences.en: And the darkness.
sentences.zh: 还有那黑暗。

sentences.en: How long were you out there on the boat with him?
sentences.zh: 你在船上和他待了多久？

sentences.en: It felt forever, but I think it was a couple hours, something like that.
sentences.zh: 感觉像过了一个世纪，但我觉得大概也就几个小时吧，差不多那样。

sentences.en: And remember I was saying that the couple that came from the harbor, they had no shirts.
sentences.zh: 还记得我说过那对从港口过来的人吗，他们没穿上衣。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The guy was like burnt everywhere and he had like blood oozing from his leg.
sentences.zh: 那男的浑身烧伤，腿上还在渗血。

sentences.en: It was pretty bad.
sentences.zh: 挺严重的。

sentences.en: And then the girl, it wasn't as bad.
sentences.zh: 至于那女孩，情况稍微好点。

sentences.en: She came and she gave me a pair of underwear to like cover the smoke because there's still smoke out there.
sentences.zh: 她走过来给了我一条内裤，让我捂住口鼻挡挡烟，因为外面到处都是烟。

sentences.en: And I was like, I don't want to put the underwear on my nose.
sentences.zh: 我说，我可不想把内裤捂在鼻子上。

sentences.en: And then I recognized it.
sentences.zh: 然后我认出来了。

sentences.en: And it was my underwear.
sentences.zh: 那是我的内裤。

sentences.en: And I looked at her and she was wearing my shirt and my pair of shorts.
sentences.zh: 我看向她，她身上穿着我的衬衫和短裤。

sentences.en: And I said, where'd you get this?
sentences.zh: 我问，你从哪儿弄来的？

sentences.en: And she said, oh, I got it from the harbor.
sentences.zh: 她说，哦，我在港口拿的。

sentences.en: So then I took the underwear and I covered myself.
sentences.zh: 于是我拿过那条内裤，捂住了自己。

sentences.en: And I was like, okay, this is mine.
sentences.zh: 我心想，好吧，这确实是我的。

sentences.en: Did you tell her?
sentences.zh: 你告诉她了吗？

sentences.en: What did she say?
sentences.zh: 她怎么说？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 说了。

sentences.en: This is my shirt.
sentences.zh: 这是我的衬衫。

sentences.en: I bought this in Vegas like 2016.
sentences.zh: 我2016年左右在拉斯维加斯买的。

sentences.en: And she had to cover herself.
sentences.zh: 她当时也得找东西遮身。

sentences.en: I get it.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: She was like in her bathing suit and it was burning.
sentences.zh: 她当时只穿着泳衣，周围都在燃烧。

sentences.en: So she was wearing my clothes.
sentences.zh: 所以她穿了我的衣服。

sentences.en: This was all from your backpack?
sentences.zh: 这些都是你背包里的？

sentences.en: This is right from my backpack.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是我背包里的。

sentences.en: The other one that I left there.
sentences.zh: 我留在那里没带走的那个。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And so we got to Malia Harbor.
sentences.zh: 后来我们到了马利亚港。

sentences.en: And there's a bunch of, you know, Coast Guard waiting for us.
sentences.zh: 那里有一群，你知道，海岸警卫队在等着我们。

sentences.en: And then, you know, they grabbed us and made sure we got to land.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们把我们接过去，确保我们安全上岸。

sentences.en: And they directed us through to a bus, a city bus.
sentences.zh: 他们指引我们去坐一辆公交车，一辆城市公交。

sentences.en: So where did the bus take you?
sentences.zh: 那公交车把你们带到哪儿了？

sentences.en: To Maui High School.
sentences.zh: 毛伊高中。

sentences.en: So they made a shelter there.
sentences.zh: 他们在那里设了个避难所。

sentences.en: And I mean, it was just a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我是说，那里人真的很多。

sentences.en: The big TV and the news playing.
sentences.zh: 大电视上放着新闻。

sentences.en: Everybody standing looking.
sentences.zh: 每个人都站着看。

sentences.en: And then when we arrived, of course, we were like covering suit and all black.
sentences.zh: 我们刚到的时候，当然了，我们身上全是灰，黑乎乎的。

sentences.en: So everyone was looking at us.
sentences.zh: 所以大家都盯着我们看。

sentences.en: And I was barefoot.
sentences.zh: 而且我没穿鞋。

sentences.en: The people kept staring at my feet.
sentences.zh: 人们一直盯着我的脚看。

sentences.en: Everybody knew, you know, we're the ones who survived.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，我们是幸存者。

sentences.en: You know, everybody that was in the shelter or the lucky ones.
sentences.zh: 你知道，避难所里的每个人都是幸运儿。

sentences.en: So everybody was kind of quiet.
sentences.zh: 所以大家都很安静。

sentences.en: It was a quiet night.
sentences.zh: 那是一个安静的夜晚。

sentences.en: And so we signed in with the Red Cross.
sentences.zh: 我们去红十字会登记了。

sentences.en: And I got examined by the nurse.
sentences.zh: 护士给我做了检查。

sentences.en: And she listened to one of my lungs.
sentences.zh: 她听了听我的一侧肺部。

sentences.en: And she said that my lung, you know, I need to get checked out.
sentences.zh: 她说我的肺，你知道，我得去仔细检查一下。

sentences.en: And my hand as well.
sentences.zh: 还有我的手也是。

sentences.en: You know, she's like, wow, it's probably broken.
sentences.zh: 她说，哇，这可能骨折了。

sentences.en: And I got a blanket.
sentences.zh: 我领了一条毯子。

sentences.en: And I went and I found the corner of the gym, like all the way in the back.
sentences.zh: 我走到体育馆的一个角落，就在最里面。

sentences.en: There was no one.
sentences.zh: 那里没人。

sentences.en: And then I just went by myself.
sentences.zh: 我就一个人待着。

sentences.en: And I just put my headphones on, but I didn't have anything.
sentences.zh: 我戴上耳机，虽然里面什么也没放。

sentences.en: Just to kind of stop the noise, the echoes.
sentences.zh: 只是为了隔绝噪音和回声。

sentences.en: I needed to be alone.
sentences.zh: 我需要独处。

sentences.en: Could you see Damien?
sentences.zh: 你能看到达米安吗？

sentences.en: Damien was still eating.
sentences.zh: 达米安还在吃东西。

sentences.en: So he was doing pretty good.
sentences.zh: 他状态还不错。

sentences.en: Was he talking to people?
sentences.zh: 他有跟人交流吗？

sentences.en: He was talking to everyone.
sentences.zh: 他在跟每个人说话。

sentences.en: Damien is a, yeah, he's a chatter.
sentences.zh: 达米安是个，嗯，他是个话痨。

sentences.en: And when he called me today, he's like, I'll never forget you.
sentences.zh: 今天他给我打电话时说，我永远不会忘记你。

sentences.en: He was a little drunk.
sentences.zh: 他喝了点酒。

sentences.en: And I guess he was coping with it.
sentences.zh: 我想他是在借此排解吧。

sentences.en: And, you know, he said that we were brothers for life now.
sentences.zh: 而且，他说我们现在是生死之交了。

sentences.en: Did you think that too?
sentences.zh: 你也这么想吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, me and him went through something that, you know, not a lot of people went through.
sentences.zh: 是的，我和他经历了一些，你知道，没多少人经历过的事。

sentences.en: So, yeah, it was something I'll never forget.
sentences.zh: 所以，那是我永远不会忘记的经历。

sentences.en: How long were you in the shelter?
sentences.zh: 你在避难所待了多久？

sentences.en: I was there for...
sentences.zh: 我在那儿待了……

sentences.en: And where are you now, Idris?
sentences.zh: 那你现在在哪儿，伊德里斯？

sentences.en: We were at a hotel.
sentences.zh: 我们在一家酒店。

sentences.en: We were just waiting.
sentences.zh: 我们就在等消息。

sentences.en: We don't know what's going on.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: So no one knows what they're going to do.
sentences.zh: 没人知道接下来该怎么办。

sentences.en: I mean, I'm telling you, I don't even have shoes.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我连鞋都没有。

sentences.en: You know, and I don't want to complain because I'm alive and I feel like I shouldn't be.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我不想抱怨，因为我还活着，我觉得我不该还活着。

sentences.en: You know?
sentences.zh: 你懂吗？

sentences.en: But I don't know what to feel right now.
sentences.zh: 但我现在不知道该有什么感觉。

sentences.en: I feel loSt.
sentences.zh: 我感到迷茫。

sentences.en: And I lost literally everything.
sentences.zh: 我失去了一切。

sentences.en: Everything I had.
sentences.zh: 我拥有的一切。

sentences.en: And never get it back.
sentences.zh: 再也找不回来了。

sentences.en: And, you know, I was down to like the last cabinets.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我当时只差最后几个柜子就装好了。

sentences.en: And I had just the curtains to put up in my room.
sentences.zh: 我房间里只差窗帘没挂上。

sentences.en: And then I was done with my new place.
sentences.zh: 然后我的新家就彻底弄好了。

sentences.en: Everything was brand new.
sentences.zh: 一切都是全新的。

sentences.en: I worked so hard, you know, to have what I have.
sentences.zh: 我那么努力工作，才拥有了这一切。

sentences.en: And then to find out, I was one week away from being insured.
sentences.zh: 结果发现，我离保险生效只差一周。

sentences.en: And I lost everything.
sentences.zh: 我失去了一切。

sentences.en: I was literally, I needed one more curtain for my bedroom.
sentences.zh: 我真的，只差一个卧室窗帘。

sentences.en: And that's it.
sentences.zh: 就差那一点。

sentences.en: I was home.
sentences.zh: 我就到家了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I worked so hard.
sentences.zh: 我工作得那么辛苦。

sentences.en: And I felt guilty because I'm complaining about my possession when people lost, you know, their loved ones.
sentences.zh: 我感到内疚，因为当人们失去了亲人时，我却在抱怨我的财物。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So, Mike, my colleagues and I at The Daily have been talking to survivors of the Hawaii fire.
sentences.zh: 迈克，我和《每日新闻》的同事们一直在采访夏威夷火灾的幸存者。

sentences.en: And we just heard one of those stories from a man named Idris, a survivor.
sentences.zh: 我们刚刚听到了其中一位幸存者伊德里斯讲述的故事。

sentences.en: And at the end of our conversation, he had some questions that I think a lot of us have about how so many people could have died.
sentences.zh: 在谈话结束时，他提出了一些问题，我想我们很多人都在思考：为什么会有这么多人丧生？

sentences.en: You know, what went wrong?
sentences.zh: 你知道，到底是哪里出了问题？

sentences.en: So, you've been in Maui reporting, and we wanted to ask you some of these questions.
sentences.zh: 你一直在毛伊岛进行报道，所以我们想问你一些这样的问题。

sentences.en: First, I want to start with setting the table with a few things we do know, which is we know that the fire started around 630 in the morning,
sentences.zh: 首先，我想先梳理一下我们已知的情况：我们知道火灾是在早上6点30分左右开始的，

sentences.en: most likely from a downed power line that sparked on dry grass.
sentences.zh: 很可能是因为倒下的电线在干草上引发了火花。

sentences.en: And we also know that firefighters responded to that, and around mid-morning, they declared it contained.
sentences.zh: 我们也知道消防员对此做出了响应，并在上午中旬左右宣布火势已得到控制。

sentences.en: But obviously it wasn't.
sentences.zh: 但显然事实并非如此。

sentences.en: So, why don't you pick up from there, Mike?
sentences.zh: 那么，迈克，你从那里接着说好吗？

sentences.en: How did this essentially low-grade brush fire turn into this monster?
sentences.zh: 这场本质上低强度的灌木丛火灾是如何演变成这场灾难的？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, that day you had a real confluence of factors that set up the disaster.
sentences.zh: 是的，那天确实有多种因素交织在一起，酿成了这场灾难。

sentences.en: You had some really strong winds coming down the mountainside that a lot of people have attributed to a hurricane passing a few hundred miles to the south.
sentences.zh: 当时有非常强劲的阵风从山坡上吹下，许多人将其归因于飓风在南面几百英里处经过。

sentences.en: You had a drought that had been in the region for quite some time.
sentences.zh: 该地区已经持续干旱了很长一段时间。

sentences.en: You had these really dry, invasive grasses, some non-native species that have been there since the island's plantation days or the aftermath of the plantation days.
sentences.zh: 还有那些非常干燥的入侵性杂草，一些非本地物种，自岛上的种植园时代或种植园时代结束后就一直存在。

sentences.en: And, you know, I think you really had this other factor of firefighters being stretched thin.
sentences.zh: 而且，我认为还有一个因素是消防力量捉襟见肘。

sentences.en: This was a bad fire day across the island.
sentences.zh: 那天岛上到处都在起火，情况非常糟糕。

sentences.en: They were strained across a few different places and didn't have their full capacity in Lahaina when things started getting out of control.
sentences.zh: 他们在几个不同的地方疲于奔命，当拉海纳的情况开始失控时，他们无法投入全部力量。

sentences.en: And so early morning, there was this fire up on the hillside, more than a mile above the commercial district, the front street area of Lahaina.
sentences.zh: 清晨，在拉海纳商业区和前街区上方一英里多的山坡上发生了火灾。

sentences.en: They declare it contained and eventually start, you know, going off to do other things.
sentences.zh: 他们宣布火势得到控制，然后就去处理其他事情了。

sentences.en: But one of the neighbors I talked to said there was still just bits of smoke, like the ground was hot, like there was still just something smoldering there.
sentences.zh: 但我采访的一位邻居说，当时仍有零星烟雾，地面很烫，就像还有东西在阴燃一样。

sentences.en: And as the afternoon went on, the winds are roaring and all of a sudden the flames are back.
sentences.zh: 随着下午的推移，狂风呼啸，火焰突然又卷土重来。

sentences.en: And at that point, the winds are so strong that these little embers that are getting tossed into the air are soaring down the hillside.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，风力如此强劲，以至于被卷入空中的小火星顺着山坡飞速蔓延。

sentences.en: They're, you know, racing down the hillside.
sentences.zh: 它们顺着山坡疾驰而下。

sentences.en: The winds are so fast that the fire starts to skip down and pretty soon it's just headed towards some of the densest housing neighborhoods in town.
sentences.zh: 风速太快，火势开始跳跃式蔓延，很快就直奔镇上人口最密集的住宅区而去。

sentences.en: And the people we've talked to in that neighborhood said they essentially had no chance to prepare for evacuation, no warning that they should be getting out.
sentences.zh: 我们在那个社区采访的人说，他们基本上没有机会准备撤离，也没有接到任何应该离开的警告。

sentences.en: The fire was on top of them so faSt.
sentences.zh: 火势来得太快，瞬间就烧到了他们面前。

sentences.en: Yeah, to that point, we heard from Idris and other people we talked to that, you know, there was no alarm, right?
sentences.zh: 是的，说到这一点，我们从伊德里斯和其他人那里听说，当时没有任何警报，对吧？

sentences.en: No warning.
sentences.zh: 没有任何警告。

sentences.en: Like people didn't even know to get out until the fire was basically on their doorstep.
sentences.zh: 人们甚至不知道要撤离，直到火势基本上烧到了家门口。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's interesting because the community has these warning sirens throughout town.
sentences.zh: 是的，这很有趣，因为社区在镇上各处都设有警报器。

sentences.en: And every month, residents there get to hear them.
sentences.zh: 居民们每个月都能听到它们的声音。

sentences.en: They have this whirring horn sound.
sentences.zh: 它们会发出那种嗡嗡的号角声。

sentences.en: And it's called an all-hazard system.
sentences.zh: 这被称为“全灾害系统”。

sentences.en: But the county is saying that it's really a system not designed for fire.
sentences.zh: 但县政府表示，这套系统其实并非为火灾设计。

sentences.en: It's designed for things like a tsunami.
sentences.zh: 它是为海啸之类的情况设计的。

sentences.en: They felt like it was really not something that they had planned and considered to use in the event of a fire.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这确实不是他们在火灾发生时计划和考虑使用的手段。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people, a lot of the residents feel like this would have been the ideal circumstance to use it.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人，很多居民都觉得这本应是使用它的理想情况。

sentences.en: But cell service was going down, electricity was getting knocked out.
sentences.zh: 但当时手机信号中断，电力也被切断了。

sentences.en: When there's so many people sitting in their homes and they have no idea what's coming, something that could jar them to awareness that they may soon be incinerated,
sentences.zh: 当有那么多人待在家里，完全不知道危险即将来临时，如果能有什么东西惊醒他们，让他们意识到自己可能很快就会被大火吞噬，

sentences.en: I think would have been, to a lot of people, a big help.
sentences.zh: 我想对很多人来说，那将是一个巨大的帮助。

sentences.en: Okay, so once people realize the fire is a big problem and it's starting to roar into the town of Lahaina and they need to get out, what happens then?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么当人们意识到火灾是个大问题，并且开始向拉海纳镇蔓延，他们需要撤离时，接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: What do they do?
sentences.zh: 他们做了什么？

sentences.en: A lot of people we talked to mentioned traffic jams, everybody on the same road gunning their engines trying to get out and getting stuck.
sentences.zh: 我们采访的许多人都提到了交通堵塞，每个人都在同一条路上猛踩油门试图逃离，结果却被困住了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know, I think it's important to know there's really only two roads in and out of town.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为重要的是要知道进出该镇的道路实际上只有两条。

sentences.en: And one of them, the fire was going across.
sentences.zh: 其中一条路被火势阻断了。

sentences.en: It was closed off through the fire.
sentences.zh: 火灾导致那条路被封锁。

sentences.en: The other, we know there were, at different points, power lines that had fallen across the road.
sentences.zh: 至于另一条路，我们知道在不同地点都有电线倒塌在路上。

sentences.en: And critically, you know, once they were on the roads, people had no way to pass them.
sentences.zh: 最关键的是，一旦他们上了路，人们根本无法绕过这些障碍。

sentences.en: They were waiting for crews to come clear the roads.
sentences.zh: 他们只能等待救援人员来清理道路。

sentences.en: You can see the traffic jams in some of the videos starting to build as people wait for a way to get south, a way to get north, a way to get anywhere out of town.
sentences.zh: 你可以在一些视频中看到交通堵塞的情况，人们都在等待向南、向北或离开小镇的任何出路。

sentences.en: And to make matters worse, you know, the fire crews are racing around and initially trying to slow the spread of the fire.
sentences.zh: 更糟糕的是，消防人员在四处奔波，最初试图减缓火势蔓延。

sentences.en: But soon, we were talking to some of them that they were tapping into hydrants and the stream was getting weaker.
sentences.zh: 但很快，我们采访的一些消防员说，他们连接消防栓时，水流变得越来越弱。

sentences.en: You know, the spray would come out and it would, the wind was so strong, it would just turn to miSt.
sentences.zh: 喷出的水流，因为风力太强，直接变成了水雾。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: And then by the time they got further down the hill, the hydrants are basically empty.
sentences.zh: 等到他们到达山下更远的地方时，消防栓基本上已经没水了。

sentences.en: The county now says that the fire had burned so much so fast that there were homes all over town leaking water.
sentences.zh: 县政府现在表示，火势蔓延得太快，导致镇上到处都有房屋水管破裂漏水。

sentences.en: And it left the firefighters with nothing to fight this fire.
sentences.zh: 这让消防员在扑救这场大火时束手无策。

sentences.en: They were left watching the town burn with no way to stop it.
sentences.zh: 他们只能眼睁睁看着小镇被烧毁，却无力阻止。

sentences.en: And then instead were forced into basically try and get people out of town, try and direct them.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们被迫转而尝试疏散民众，引导他们撤离。

sentences.en: And even then, they were down on Front Street, stuck there.
sentences.zh: 即便如此，他们当时在前街也被困住了。

sentences.en: And that's where things really just turned into a death trap.
sentences.zh: 而那里最终变成了一个死亡陷阱。

sentences.en: So, Mike, hearing you talk about all of this and really lay out these problems, you know, clearly this was an extraordinarily unlucky series of events.
sentences.zh: 所以，迈克，听你说了这一切，把这些问题摆出来，显然这是一系列极其不幸的事件。

sentences.en: You know, fire from a downed power line driven by hurricane-forced winds roars into this town.
sentences.zh: 倒下的电线引发火灾，在飓风级大风的助推下席卷了这座小镇。

sentences.en: And because of other power lines that are down, the roads are closed.
sentences.zh: 而且由于其他电线倒塌，道路也被封锁了。

sentences.en: But also, it sounds maybe like some of this could have been avoided.
sentences.zh: 但听起来，也许其中一些是可以避免的。

sentences.en: Like, to what degree was this bad luck versus human error?
sentences.zh: 比如，这在多大程度上是运气不好，又在多大程度上是人为失误？

sentences.en: I think there's certainly a sense that this confluence of factors would have been really hard to overcome, that this was going to be a serious and devastating situation,
sentences.zh: 我认为人们确实有一种感觉，即这种多种因素的汇合是非常难以克服的，无论火势一旦形成后响应有多迅速，这都将是一场严重且毁灭性的灾难。

sentences.en: no matter how swift the response once the fire took hold.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，我们确实错失了很多减缓火势蔓延并挽救更多生命的机会。

sentences.en: At the same time, we have a situation with a lot of missed opportunities to have slowed the spread of the fire and save more people.
sentences.zh: 你知道，针对电力公司的诉讼已经开始了，质疑他们在火灾发生前是否应该切断电源。

sentences.en: You know, there's already lawsuits against the electric company, challenging them on whether they should have cut off power before the fire even started.
sentences.zh: 还有关于电线抢修人员的问题，以及在人们试图逃生时，他们是否本可以做更多工作来清理道路。

sentences.en: Questions about the crews on the power lines and whether they could have done more to clear roads at the time when people were trying to escape.
sentences.zh: 州总检察长正在进行一项调查，探索整个野火事件及其应对措施。

sentences.en: There's an investigation from the state attorney general that's exploring the overall wildfire and the response.
sentences.zh: 包括预警系统、县政府本可以做的准备工作，以及消防部门可用的资源。

sentences.en: The warning system, the preparations the county could have done, the resources available for the fire department.
sentences.zh: 我想在未来几年里，会有很多问题需要解答。

sentences.en: There's going to be a lot of questions for, I think, several years.
sentences.zh: 但我认为从大局来看，在这样一个有这么多人向往居住的地方，西毛伊岛的未来将面临许多疑问。

sentences.en: But I think in the bigger picture, there's going to be a lot of questions about the future of West Maui in a place where so many people want to live.
sentences.zh: 这里有这么多想留下的居民，也有想来的游客。

sentences.en: There's so many residents that want to be here, tourists that want to come.
sentences.zh: 这是一个有着深厚历史的特殊地方，曾是夏威夷王国的首都。

sentences.en: It's a special place with a deep history, former capital of the Hawaiian kingdom.
sentences.zh: 如今，这里的资源承受着压力。

sentences.en: And these days, there's a strain on the resources.
sentences.zh: 干旱加剧，风力增强，人们感觉到这里的野火风险也将持续扩大。

sentences.en: There's growing drought, there's growing winds, and there's a sense that the wildfire risk here is going to continue expanding as well.
sentences.zh: 这确实引发了一些关于拉海纳未来的问题，因为现在这个社区不得不从零开始。

sentences.en: And it really raises some questions about the future of Lahaina at a time when, right now, this community kind of has to start from scratch.
sentences.zh: 并防止这种集体痛苦再次发生。

sentences.en: And prevent something with this much collective anguish from ever happening again.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
